reason: Water, yerba mate and fruit concentrate is exactly the label I want to see, and I need something for night shifts that isn't a can of sweeteners and additives. I'd grab one in a café to try it, maybe a second time, but not more on my money.
objection: 55 CZK a can is more than a Red Bull and I'm on a tight budget, so this can't become a daily thing. Also no sugar listed at all, so I wonder if it tastes like sour grass water.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper multipack price on the e-shop, closer to 40 CZK a can, would make me buy it regularly instead of once in a while.
